caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a fitted lid, likely a jar or canister, positioned upright and centered on the page. The container is predominantly brown in color with reddish and ochre tones, highlighted and detailed with black and white accents. The surface of the jar features multiple horizontal bands of decorative motifs: the uppermost band near the lid has a wavy pattern in white, followed by a band with repeating black circular shapes framed by vertical lines, and a lower band with a white wavy and dotted motif. The lid is domed, crowned with a small knob-like handle at the top, and decorated with circular bands and dots. The edges of the paper around the drawing are angular and cut, and the drawing itself appears to be mounted on a pale, neutral background. A signature is visible in red in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
